desc:
🩺 SAVE A LIFE! 🩺

Grab a friend and scrub in. One of you is the Surgeon, the other is the Nurse, and the patient is counting on you both.

👨‍⚕️ SURGEON: Operate! Remove swallowed toys, swap organs, patch up bleeds and stitch him closed.
👩‍⚕️ NURSE: Read the checklist, fetch new organs, run the machines and keep your surgeon on track.

Talk it through with voice chat, text chat or the quick-call wheel. Playing solo? Robot Nurse Beep has your back!

⭐ FEATURES
• Story Mode: 8 crazy patients. Race the clock for the best grade.
• Endless Mode: how many lives can you save in one shift?
• Leaderboards for the fastest runs and most lives saved
• Unlock scrubs, gloves and tool sets in the shop

🚧 Save A Life! is brand new, so you might run into the odd bug. Found one? Let us know in the group so we can fix it fast. Story: Hard is coming soon!

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite to follow updates!
